AdminAction.description: What an admin (or the command line, with no actor) did.
AdminAction.title: AdminAction

AdminEvent.description: `actor` is null for the command line or a deleted admin, `target` for a deleted user.
AdminEvent.title: AdminEvent

AdminUserUpdate.description: Only the fields that are sent change.
AdminUserUpdate.title: AdminUserUpdate

file.description: A JPEG, PNG or WebP image of at most 10 MB.
file.title: File

Category.description: Shown as the translation `category.<key>`, in `sort_order` (the shop's walking order).
Category.title: Category

CategoryOrder.description: Every category id exactly once, in the new order.
CategoryOrder.title: CategoryOrder

CodeInfo.description: A usable code. `username` is set for reset codes only (the account being reset).
CodeInfo.title: CodeInfo

CoupleState.description: The own couple (`partner`, accepted at `since`) and pending requests.
CoupleState.title: CoupleState

Cuisine.description: Seeded cuisines have a `key` (translation `cuisine.<key>`), user-added ones a `name`.
Cuisine.title: Cuisine

ErrorCode.description: What went wrong; the frontend shows the translation `error.<code>`.
ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode

ErrorResponse.description: `params` fill placeholders in the translation; `fields` lists rejected request fields.
ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

FieldError.description: One rejected request field; `loc` is its path, e.g. `["body", "name"]`.
FieldError.title: FieldError

FieldErrorCode.description: Why a single request field was rejected (`fields[].code` in the envelope).
FieldErrorCode.title: FieldErrorCode

FilterHidden.description: User filter chips this user has switched off, per screen (MEAL-10, UI-02).
FilterHidden.title: FilterHidden

Ingredient.description:
An ingredient with its manual values and the resulting nutrition (NUT-02).

`created_by` / `updated_by` are null for a deleted user (ING-06).
Ingredient.title: Ingredient

IngredientCreate.description:
`category_id` defaults to the *Other* category, `base_unit` to g (ING-02).

`piece_weight_g`: 0 < x ≤ 10000; `density_g_per_ml`: 0.1 ≤ x ≤ 5.
IngredientCreate.title: IngredientCreate

IngredientSummary.description: A search result or list entry.
IngredientSummary.title: IngredientSummary

IngredientUpdate.description:
Only the fields that are sent change; an explicit null clears the piece weight or
density, and is refused for the name, category and base unit (422 `invalid`). `manual`
changes only the nutrients it contains (null clears one).

The base unit cannot change while products are linked (409 `ingredient.base_unit_locked`).
IngredientUpdate.title: IngredientUpdate

InviteCreate.description: `tailscale_share_url`: the optional share link for step 1 of the invite message.
InviteCreate.title: InviteCreate

InviteCreated.description: The new invite and its link (`/join#<code>`); the code is shown only this once.
InviteCreated.title: InviteCreated

LinkCreated.description: A reset link; the code is in the fragment (`/reset#<code>`).
LinkCreated.title: LinkCreated

LoginResponse.description: `access_token` goes into `Authorization: Bearer`; it expires after `expires_in` s.
LoginResponse.title: LoginResponse

MeUpdate.description: Only the fields that are sent change (ACC-13, VIS-02, I18N-01).
MeUpdate.title: MeUpdate

Meal.description: A meal as its viewer sees it; `is_owner` tells whether they may edit it (VIS-04).
Meal.title: Meal

MealBasedOn.description:
The original of a copy, shown as "based on X by Y" (MEAL-08) while the original exists
and the viewer may see it.
MealBasedOn.title: MealBasedOn

MealCreate.title: MealCreate

MealIngredientInput.description:
`amount`: 0 < x ≤ 100000. An amount without a unit counts as pieces; a unit without an
amount is refused (`ingredients.<i>.amount` `required`). An empty note is stored as null.
MealIngredientInput.title: MealIngredientInput

MealIngredientRow.description: An ingredient row; `amount` and `unit` are both null for e.g. "salt, to taste".
MealIngredientRow.title: MealIngredientRow

MealNutrition.description:
Totals over the rows that could be counted (NUT-03); a nutrient is null only if nothing
contributed to it. `incomplete` if anything is `missing` (NUT-04); `estimate` if spoons of
a g-based ingredient without density were counted as 1 g/ml (NUT-05). The totals are not
bounded by the per-100 maximums of `NutrientValues`.
MealNutrition.title: MealNutrition

MealNutritionMissing.description:
Why a row does not (fully) count: no amount, an amount that cannot be converted to the
ingredient's base unit, or an unknown value for `nutrient` (NUT-04).
MealNutritionMissing.title: MealNutritionMissing

MealPhoto.description: Signed URLs of the photo and its thumbnail; they expire after 1 to 2 hours (VIS-05).
MealPhoto.title: MealPhoto

MealSummary.description: A meal in the meal list; `thumb_url` is a signed URL of the photo's thumbnail.
MealSummary.title: MealSummary

MealUpdate.description:
Only the fields that are sent change, with the rules of `MealCreate`. An explicit null
clears the instructions, source link or cuisine, and is refused for the other fields (422
`invalid`). `tags` and `ingredients` replace the whole list.
MealUpdate.title: MealUpdate

NutrientInfo.description:
An ingredient's value for one nutrient, decided field by field (NUT-02): the manual
value, else the average over its products that have one, else unknown (null, never 0).
`products_mean` is that average (shown as a hint next to a manual value).
NutrientInfo.title: NutrientInfo

NutrientValues.description: Values per 100 g or 100 ml; null means unknown. In requests every value must be plausible: 0 up to the nutrient's maximum (900 kcal, 100 g for the others).
NutrientValues.title: NutrientValues

Product.description:
`nutrients` are per 100 g or 100 ml (`nutrition_basis`, always the ingredient's base
unit). `user_edited_fields` names the fields a user typed or changed (`name`,
`nutrients.kcal`, ...); Open Food Facts never overwrites them (BAR-04).
Product.title: Product

ProductCreate.description:
A product entered by hand. The barcode is EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A or UPC-E with a valid
check digit (spaces are ignored); it is stored as EAN-13 (UPC-A with a leading 0, UPC-E
expanded first), an EAN-8 as it is. `nutrition_basis` defaults to the ingredient's base unit
and must match it (409 `product.basis_mismatch`).
ProductCreate.title: ProductCreate

ProductUpdate.description:
Only the fields that are sent change (null clears an optional one; it is refused for
the barcode, ingredient and basis with 422 `invalid`); each becomes user-edited.
`ingredient_id` moves the product to another ingredient, whose base unit must match the
nutrition basis.
ProductUpdate.title: ProductUpdate

RefreshRequest.description: `fork` asks for a new, independent session (first start of the Home Screen app).
RefreshRequest.title: RefreshRequest

SecurityInfo.description:
What *Me → Security* shows, e.g. "Password reset by X on <date>" (ACC-10).

`password_reset_by` is null for a reset link from the command line or a deleted admin.
SecurityInfo.title: SecurityInfo

SessionInfo.description: A logged-in device; `current` is the one making this request (ACC-09).
SessionInfo.title: SessionInfo

Unit.description: The fixed units; the order is the display order.
Unit.title: Unit

UserRef.description: Another user as everyone sees them; deactivated users are shown with a note (ADM-02).
UserRef.title: UserRef

VersionInfo.description: What is running and where its source is (LIC-02, AGPL § 13).
VersionInfo.title: VersionInfo

HTTPBearer.description: The access token from login, refresh, join or reset.

put.description: Set the category order to the shop's walking order; every category exactly once.

get.description: The admin activity log, newest first (at most 200 entries).

delete.description: Delete an ingredient that nothing refers to (409 `ingredient.in_use` otherwise).

post.description:
Merge a duplicate into `into_id`: its references move there and it is deleted
(ING-05). Returns the ingredient merged into.

get.description: All invites with their status, newest first.

post.description: A new invite link (ACC-02); the link is returned only this once.

delete.description: Revoke an invite so it can no longer be used.

get.description: All users, by display name.

delete.description: Delete another user and their data (ADM-03).

patch.description: Change another user's role or deactivate/reactivate them.

post.description: A single-use password reset link for the user (ACC-10); older ones stop working.
Whether an invite or reset code can be used; does not consume it (ACC-04).
Reports whether the browser sent the diagnostics cookie.
Sets the diagnostics cookie.
Register with an invite code and log in (ACC-01, ACC-05, ACC-07).
Log in with username and password; sets the refresh cookie (throttled, ACC-11).
Log out this device: revoke the cookie's session and remove the cookie.
Log out every device of the user, this one included (ACC-09).

A new access token (and rotated cookie) for the refresh cookie.

Needs the header `X-MealMate-Client: web` (CSRF guard). `{"fork": true}` starts a new,
independent session instead (first start of the Home Screen app).
Set a new password with a reset code; ends all other sessions and logs in (ACC-10).

get.description: All categories in the shop's walking order.

delete.description: End the couple (either partner, any time).

get.description: The partner, if any, and pending requests.

post.description: Send a couple request to another active user.
Accept a request sent to you; cancels all other pending requests of both users.
Withdraw your own request.
Decline a request sent to you.

get.description: Seeded cuisines in their fixed order, then the ones users added, by name.

post.description: Add a cuisine as plain text (201), or get the existing one with that name (200).

200.description: A cuisine with this name (ignoring case and umlauts) exists already

get.description: Checks that the database answers and the data directory is writable.

503.description: The database or the data directory is unavailable

get.description:
Search ignoring case, umlauts and accents (`q`), prefix matches first; without `q`,
all ingredients by category order and name (at most 1000).

post.description: Add an ingredient; the name must be unique ignoring case and umlauts.

get.description: Up to five ingredients with a similar name, for the "similar ingredient exists" hint.
An ingredient with its nutrition per nutrient and where each value comes from.

patch.description: Change an ingredient (anyone may); the base unit is locked while products are linked.

get.description: The ingredient's products, by name and barcode.
The own profile and settings.

patch.description: Change display name, language, privacy switches or hidden filter chips.

post.description: Change the password; logs out all other devices (throttled like login, ACC-11).

get.description: Password change and reset notices ("Password reset by X on <date>").
The own logged-in devices, most recently used first.

delete.description: Log out one of the own devices.

get.description:
The meals you can see, A-Z. `q` searches names, tags and cuisines ignoring case and
umlauts. Without `owner_ids`, owners you switched off in your filter chips
(`filter_hidden.meals`) are left out; with `owner_ids` (repeatable), only those owners'
meals are listed.

post.description: Add a meal of your own; only the name is required.

get.description:
The tags on the meals you can see, A-Z, for the tag filter. Unlike `/api/tags` it has no
limit and ignores your filter chips.
A meal you can see (404 otherwise), with nutrition and signed photo URLs.

patch.description: Change your meal; `tags` and `ingredients` replace the whole list.

post.description: Copy a meal you can see to your meals, with its own copy of the photo ("based on").

delete.description: Remove the photo of your meal.

put.description:
Set the photo of your meal (at most 20 uploads per 10 minutes). It is rotated upright,
re-encoded without metadata and stored with a thumbnail; errors: 413 `media.too_large`,
415 `media.unsupported_type`, 422 `media.too_many_pixels`.

get.description:
A photo or thumbnail from a signed URL of a meal response. 404 `common.not_found` for
an unknown name, a wrong or expired signature, or a deleted photo.

parameters.description: Expiry (Unix time), from the signed URL.
parameters.name: exp

schema.description: Expiry (Unix time), from the signed URL.
schema.title: Exp

post.description: Add a product by hand; its nutrition basis must be the ingredient's base unit.

get.description: One product.

patch.description: Change a product (anyone may); every field sent is marked user-edited.

get.description: Tags for autocomplete: at most 20 whose name contains `q`, prefix matches first.
All units in display order, with their kind.
All active users except yourself, by display name.

Users whose meals (`for=meals`) or lists (`for=lists`) you can see: yourself first,
your partner, and everyone whose matching privacy switch is public.
The running version and a link to its source code.
